newsitem.title: USA: Applied sees $4 mln Q1 charge for Invetech.
newsitem.headline: Applied sees $4 mln Q1 charge for Invetech.

text.p: Applied Industrial Technologies Inc said Thursday that it expects to incur a pre-tax nonrecurring charge of about $4 million in its first quarter ending September 30, 1997, in connection with the recently-completed acquisition of privately-held Invetech Co.
Applied Industrial bought the concern, a distributor of industrial components, for cash and stock valued at $83 million.
The company also said that the acquisition is expected to increase sales by over 25 percent for the fiscal year ending June 30, 1998.
Applied Industrial had sales of $1.14 billion in fiscal 1996.
Applied Industrial is a distributor of bearings, mechanical and electrical drive systems, industrial rubber products, fluid power components and specialty maintenance and repair products.
